title: Portfolio Content Intake
description: Use this file as the place to paste new content before we convert it into content/*.ts or page copy. Keep it simple. Write in first person. Use bullets. Do not worry about perfect wording on the first pass.
guidelines: Use 'TBD' only when you intentionally do not know something yet.
Do not add claims unless you can back them up.
Write as 'I built,' 'I learned,' 'I decided,' 'I improved.'
Avoid 'Tanmay built,' 'he worked on,' or third-person language.
